title: The Songbook of Junebug Creek
author: Paloma Whitlock
blurb: Cyrus Vane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
